cases.name: depth-positive

files.src/job.py:
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession, DataFrame
from pyspark.sql.streaming import DataStreamWriter
def run(writer):
    spark = SparkSession.builder.getOrCreate()
    df = spark.read.csv('input')
    DataFrame.select(df, 'id')
    DataFrame.cache(df)
    DataFrame.repartition(df, 8)
    DataStreamWriter.start(writer)

cases.tradeoff: L2 requires Spark imports and attributed session/DataFrame calls in one authored file; helper-returned DataFrames cannot always retain type attribution.
